transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you know, the Northstar and Mosaic ERGs have their next two forums scheduled for the same week, and attendance has been declining at both forums since the groups began sharing several company-wide initiatives. I've convened this roundtable so we can discuss whether combining the forums makes sense, talk through everyone's constraints and policy requirements, and decide on a path forward. I have the authority to approve a combined forum and any temporary operating rules, so let's work through this together. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you — what constraints, observations, or requirements do you bring to this discussion?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to put something on the formal record that I've been holding back. I personally observed exactly three recent incidents where Mosaic participants were interrupted before they could finish speaking during our shared Northstar-Mosaic forums. I hadn't entered these observations into the formal forum record because the chairs and I were trying to resolve the tension informally, but I think it's critical that Mara and everyone here hear this now. Given these three documented incidents, I'm recommending that any combined forum include a speaking queue enforced by a neutral external facilitator to ensure all voices are heard fully.

If we're moving to a combined forum, we need to schedule it around that exact window so I can consistently participate.

A formal midpoint review will be conducted on day 30 of the 60-day pilot, with all roundtable participants reconvening to assess attendance, equity of participation, and whether to continue the combined format.
